text: Visited for first time today and will be back!  I had a greens bowl with chicken and all of the toppings were so flavorful and fresh. Lentil soup was also delicious!

OTTO catered our wedding and we couldn't have been more pleased.  The food was top notch and the level of service exceeded expectations.  We highly recommend OTTO to anyone in the area who is looking for an event caterer.

It is quite clean compared to many other places in America. The sarma, kısır, and the mezes in general were very delicious. We were happy to find ayran, and the portion sizes were also quite sufficient.
Delicious!! Really enjoyed the food and atmosphere. I will return for the meatball sliders that we devoured. Excellent pick and friendly staff. ❤️
Food was good but not overly flavorful. Staff was quite pleasant, and the open garage doors makes for a pleasing atmosphere.

Otto is my absolute favorite spot in Charlottesville. The food is delicious, the restaurant is always clean, the staff is personable and they remember you when you come back! We just had Otto cater our wedding dinner and we could not be more pleased. They were on time, very communicative, set up and cleaned up and provided coffee service, baklava and bartended. No notes 1000/10! I <3 Otto

Otto and their catering team led by Ali were absolutely phenomenal during our wedding dinner. They were professional, courteous, and even assisted with presenting a birthday cake for a friend who’s birthday was on our big day. I can’t say enough great things about them. EVERYONE loved the food, especially the egg plant! Our experience with Ali was nothing short of spectacular from the moment we reached out…if you’re even considering Otto for any event…just do it, you won’t regret it!

I liked the open window concept (there’s a side of the wall removed, open to the street- like outdoor-indoor seating). Love the rosemary fries- so crunchy! The beef could be a bit more tender but everything was great. The spicy mayo goes great with everything!  It was a tad bit pricey though ($~50 for two mains and fries).
Great food, excellent service, and a friendly team. Otto is a wonderful place to enjoy a delicious meal. Highly recommended!

We ordered online for pickup on their personal website, we got there and the staff told us sometimes they don’t get notified of their online orders. Why are you still using that system if you know it’s an issue??? They tell us our food will be out in 2 minutes, it takes 20. We were terribly late to a wedding rehearsal. If they had told us it would be 20 minutes, we would have canceled the order and ate later.
Reasonable price.

Amazing little spot tucked away; easy parking at the paid lot across the street and the gents working were so very kind! Exceptionally flavored and delicious food, really great deal for how much food and the quality you get! Highly recommend!

Really enjoyed our visit to Otto! The falafel were delicious, and everything was fresh and full of flavor. The restaurant was clean, the atmosphere was great, and the staff was very helpful and friendly. Definitely worth a visit!

I visited for the first time yesterday. The food was so tasty and well-seasoned! The falafel was exceptional. And the staff were so genuinely friendly. As a recent transplant to Charlottesville, I was made to feel right at home.
First time and loved it. We will be back!
The workers were super nice and friendly. The food was a very large portion for the price and felt super fresh.
Amazing place if you like turkish food. Lentil soup is amazing
Great döner for take out with amazing fries

This place is amazing!!! Friendly staff and great quality food! I ordered the Lentil Soup it was so delicious! Seasoned perfectly and a decent size portion. Hassan brought out my food and was very helpful when I placed my order!
Wow, $9.32 for hummus with pita.  It was a small portion of pita chips and a small dollop of hummus.  What a waste of money.

Omg, I had no idea a salad could be so good and don't get me started on the baklava and the chocolate pudding...seriously chocolate pudding as in Michelin Star good...yes, chocolate PUDDING folks (something I normally eskew)

Great place to grab a bite. The staff is amazingly friendly and will walk you through the options. We almost weren’t sure where to start. I ended up with the loaded fries and wrap with beef.

The fries were delicious and though they’re truly loaded, it’s all balanced really well. It’s a large order and enough to easily split with two people. The wrap is a good size and prices are good.
I wish I could give it 100 stars. Food is the best ever. Sooo fresh and love wraps love. ❤️. Lentils is awesome. Owner is awesomer.
Great food, friendly service, all around great place to stop in for a bite
Insanely good food and service was on point too. Came here for the veggie option (falafels) and my partner had the beef. They let me have an extra topping just so I could try. Love this place.
Always love stopping in when I come to Charlottesville!
Amazing food great service!!!!
Excellent food and service! Always consistent! And the baklava is outstanding.
I loved the food and the service was fantastic! Recommending to my friends!
Stupendous
Good Mediterranean food, really nice people, reasonable prices for what you get.
Everything is excellent here! I highly recommend it if you are in this area!
Nice bowls. Chicken was better.
All very good here. Clean. Nice service. Recommended.

Ottos's catereds our company lunches. I have to say they are absolutely the best!  The food is always on time and it's all very delicious. It's hard to please 32 people - but everybody here loves Otto.  Also, the owner and staff really know what good customer service is all about. We will use them often.
Cute little restaurant. It was helpful to get an assembly suggestion for my pita as it was our first time there. And the food was absolutely excellent.

Such a great place! An interesting flavorful menu. The staff is very informed  about the food and service is cheerful and quick. The flavors are SO FRESH. Colorful combinations of freshly prepared vegetables. You can choose a protein topper if desired.Marinated beef or grilled chicken or 3 Falafel . We had the beef on the bulgar salad and the falafel on the other salad. It was truly the best combo of vegs and grains and meats I’ve had in a restaurant. Prices are excellent and servings are very generous. Definitely recommend.
Very flavorful! Fresh. Generous portions. Clean restaurant space.

Believe the reviews, because this place is great!  Here on vacation and we've already visited twice.  The ottobun is delectable.  The chicken is yummy.  It tastes so good--it's hard to believe it's actually really healthy!  This restaurant also has vegan options for the vegans in your life. Certainly worth a visit!!
Delicious food as usual, but service ve started lacking compared to prior. Had to wait about 15 minutes for chicken to be ready. And of course prices went up, but that's a part of normal nowadays.

We were visiting Charlottesville from out of town and had a 30+ family gathering. Otto was able to accommodate our large group and catered our event at the last minute. Food and service were fantastic and I would definitely recommend this restaurant.

We stopped on our way to Harrisonburg for a quick, healthy dinner. Wow! Delicious! I loved the variety of salads. Very fresh. My husband got the rosemary fries and enjoyed them. We've never had rosemary on fries. It was a pleasant surprise. My husband has food allergies and they changed gloves and informed us on which dishes contain gluten and dairy. I'm sad there aren't any more of Otto's in Virginia but I guess that's why they are so good.

The food was excellent! We ordered the Ottoman Pita and the Istanbul Bowl, and both were good , fresh, and generously portioned. The service was outstanding, and the restaurant itself was cute, clean, and welcoming. Overall, a wonderful dining experience. I highly recommend it!

It was a really clean and cozy place to eat. I ordered  a chicken doner and veggie mixed bowl and it was so delicious. We had a great conversation with Fatih and Hasan who was nice, kind and great host. Truly recommended!

Delicious bowls and pitas. Great options for both vegetarians and meat (chicken and beef) eaters.

Delicious toppings, especially the beet salad.

We had the pleasure of having Ali and the Otto team cater our wedding, and we can’t say enough about how fantastic it was. The food was incredible, with tons of guests telling us how good it was. The service, including a full bar, went above and beyond. And most importantly, the entire team was so easy to work with. There’s so much to think about during your wedding day and throughout the planning process, but Otto never added to our stress. Ali especially was incredibly responsive, kind, and friendly. He didn’t just provide good food, he added to the whole experience with his energy and professionalism. So grateful for Otto!

The price is reasonable. The people who work here are nice and welcoming. I had a bowl and my friend had the loaded rosemary fries. Both were good.
The only thing about this area is the issue finding a parking spot.

Dude this place is SO GOOD. I doordashed it the first few times I had it and was so impressed by how well it traveled. The inside store is really cute and simple, comfortable enough to hang and eat but casual enough to not stay too long. Service is Chipotle-esque, so it’s quick and customizable. Portions are great, flavors are great, 10/10. Also a good introduction spot if you are new to mediterranean food.
A million stars! Chefs kiss. My favorite restaurant in Charlottesville!
Great staff. Great food. Don't miss.

I stopped by Otto Eats while visiting Virginia from Minnesota and was looking for something Mediterranean and healthier to eat. Really glad I found this place the portions were great, the food was fresh, and it filled me up without feeling heavy or sick afterward. The lady working there was also very nice and welcoming. Definitely a good spot if you want flavorful food that still feels balanced and fresh.

Ok I Decide to change the comment status. I am a nice guy. Founder Ali is a good looking guy. He is good looking as those Turkish pop stars, handsome as Turkish movie actors Mashallah! All the beautiful ladies should go there buy some food. His employees were nice to me. Food were good. "Coke güzel’’
Fantastic food at reasonable prices with a charming seating area. Run by a very friendly team, we had interactions with 3 different staff members and they were all incredibly kind and helpful.

the staff is friendly and helpful and the food is fresh and delicious . A great spot for a quick and healthy meal . The restaurant itself is very cute too , especially nice in the warmer weather as the side panels of the building open up so it’s like an indoor patio of sorts . Highly recommend !!
A true delight of an establishment. Friendly, warm and welcoming staff serving delicious, fresh and vibrant food.

When I’m in town and need something yummy, healthy, and fresh, (and gluten free) I always know I can stop at Otto’s — it’s a failsafe. Very appreciative of their super friendly staff as well! (I can’t have the baklava unfortunately, but I hear it’s top notch)

I’m a delivery driver and upon receiving the order I was picking up, I was given a chicken & feta pita by the gentlemen working. SO DELICIOUS!! I also want to give a HUGE Thank You to the gentleman that made it for me. You really made my day!!! I have been going thru some really dark stuff and just this kind gesture made a huge difference. Thank you again! 10/10 5 ⭐️

Absolutely delicious & lots of gluten free options. This is our new lunch spot when we visit Charlottesville. Service was excellent & efficient, and the seating area was really colorful & lovely. All around a great place for lunch or dinner.

Stopped here after a trip to UVA, the women working behind the counter preparing the bowls was just rude and acted annoyed when I asked questions. A guy young guy came and took over after seeing her, he was good, quick and very friendly. The food was actually really good, the open store environment was ok, to much road noise and smell of gasoline from car driving by. I will definitely go back and give them a try again.
Place is awesome. Great veggie options. Bahar is great! Makes sure everything is fresh!
The workers food and everything else was perfect

Me and my friends only had about 15 dollars on us and we got one shawarma to share between the five of us when on elf the workers saw us all sharing one shawarma she gave us  a free loaded bowl and free sodas we love you guys so much Otto’s workers are the best people to exist we love you!  💗
Great food! High quality place .. must try. Everything is so flavorful!
do not miss the awesome restaurant/cafe. very nice. rosemary fries!!
Food was good and authentic. The staff were very helpful and friendly, and the shop was spotlessly clean. We’ll be back!

Otto is the perfect spot for a quick and delicious lunch! The falafel pitas were delicious and packed with flavor. The staff were so welcoming and nice. Will be stopping by whenever we’re back in Charlottesville!

Delicious chicken doner wrap, with very flavorful chicken.  The spiced lentil soup was also great, not salty, but still tasty.  The side of pita was also terrific.  Easy takeout spot, would return if in the area.
The food is really good! Falafel was super 😋
Excellent food! Good vegan and vegetarian options. Kind staff and good service.
I was at jack school today. And i had lunch at ottos food truck i had the classic wrap very delicious btw. Service was 10/10 thanks to Leo for explaining the menu for me

I’ll start this by saying I am super white and am not the best at trying new things. However they made it so easy, they were patient and so friendly when explaining dishes and their sauces to me which I appreciated so much. The food alone is a 12/10. It is fresh, flavorful and all works together really nicely. The tzatski is amazing! I have tried a few and Otto’s is the only one I’ve had that has a fresh cucumber flavor and doesn’t just taste like Greek yogurt. You want a place that is fast, friendly, inclusive and delicious? Please make this your next stop! 10/10 highly recommend, I’m already thinking about my next order.
Super tasty! Very recommended
Quick, friendly, and delicious. Just like döner kebab I had in Europe.
Amazing owners, amazing food, amazing space. Nothing that they do was wrong. You know on the off chance that you don't like your food, they do their best to make sure you get something you like.

Great spot in Charlottesville! I ordered the chicken wrap and my wife got the chicken bowl, both were fresh, flavorful, and really satisfying. The ingredients tasted high quality and everything was prepared perfectly. Bahar was especially welcoming and really paid attention to my order modification, which I appreciated. We really enjoyed our meal and would definitely come back. Highly recommend!
I ordered a create your own bowl. Incredibly fresh ingredients, amazingly helpful staff, and it tasted incredible! If I was local this would be a regular stop.
Pretty much took over the food scene on the mall and they are mainstream only on what deals and flavor combos they have.
Awesome food with awesome service! Highly recommend!

I fell in love as soon as I walked in the door. As someone who loves culture, I could feel it instantly here. I got recommended an amazing bowl and chocolate baklava(first time having it and it was amazing!)

Had a great convo with the host and enjoyed the food. 10/10 recommend
Good food, good service, affordable prices and the bowl is  a generous portion.
Delicious Turkish eatery, wraps, bowls, fresh ingredients, great seasonings and sauces.
Delicious. I'm looking forward to theiropening in Richmond.

The best restaurant ever there was two guys take my order and they was really kind. I always eat from here but first time I want do a review because is the best place I go to the best customer service and best food.
Unmatched when it comes to taste, good service, and stellar menu. You cannot order something bad here, every last thing is perfection. Get the Ottobun Pita first, and tip the staff handsomely!

Been meaning to try this place. Popped in today for lunch (one of the few places open due to weather). Guy was friendly and helpful with recommendations. And this bowl was HEAVY, on quantity and quality!! Great value for the money, and tasted phenomenal! Close to my office, so will definitely be added to my rotation.
Leaving this review while eating their new wrap.. it’s so good, and the service was great !

Excellent food! It was fresh and flavorful. The multi colored plates added to the vibrancy of the place. Lots of interesting artwork on the walls, another feast for the eyes. A good variety of canned soda/juices as well; try the sour cherry juice. Overall, we were very happy with our choice.
Great fresh food deserts and service .
Amazing food, very friendly service
Really enjoyed the food I got here on a day trip to Charlottesville.
A true gem of cville! Worth the trip for Turkish coffee alone. The cuisine is not only delicious but also a healthier alternative to many other meals dining out.
The quality and quantity degraded . Tiny portion of food  not even half bowl for almost $17 not worth it.
Easily the best falafel I’ve ever had. I got the bowl with all the trimmings, fantastic.
The staff are far too hospitable and kind I may never leave! The food has knocked both my socks off and I am made more joyous and powerful by this love filled meal. Thank You Ottos staff!

Food is great, fries and sandwiches never disappoint. Sandwiches can drip, so get extra napkins or bags. Quick service, both at brick-and-mortar and food truck. Not quite authentic Turkish, more adapted for American palate. Inside is nicely decorated with Istanbul imagery. Owner makes sure to chat if you know him. A mainstay of Cville's Turkish community.
The sign said something like delicious, healthy, and affordable and they lived up to all three. What a gem, they were also very nice.

Otto catered my wedding and I was over the moon with their service and quality! Ali was consistent and fast to reply with whatever questions I had and he was so helpful. The food tasted incredible and it was the best food at a wedding I have ever had hands down. I waited to the last minute to decide on a caterer because it was stressing me out, but when I chose Otto there was no stress after that! They took care of everything and made the process very smooth. Also, crazy affordable for the quality of food. Thank you for adding a huge amount of peace and joy to my big day!!
The Alaturca wrap and baklava is to die for, staff are very welcoming even when dealing with heavy downtown traffic. Would highly recommend for anyone looking for a flavorful meal.

Otto catered both our welcome dinner and wedding reception, and we couldn't be more pleased with how the food turned out. Ali and his team were easy to work with leading up to our wedding (including addressing dietary restrictions) and ensured everything ran smoothly the day of the event. The food was phenomenal and received so many compliments throughout the weekend. Thank you, Otto, for feeding us all weekend!

I hope someone who works here sees this. Stop marking order ready for grubhub if youre just starting the order. I drove 6 mins away and when i got to restaurant i get a notification that food is ready. Walk in and hes just now starting it. We dont come in typically unless we get those notifications. It will prevent a lot of frustration and headache for everyone involved. Esp since you never ever seem to start it unless someone is sitting outside of the business or right in your face. Thanks for your help

Amazing Turkish-style food! We had the shawarma wrap and the shawarma chicken bowl—both were super flavorful and the chicken was juicy and perfectly seasoned. The owners were also incredibly friendly and welcoming. This spot is right in the heart of Charlottesville, VA, and is definitely a must-try!
Highly recommend Otto - delicious, and super helpful team!  They were able to help me coordinate with Uber Eats in an order I had an issue with.

We brought Otto's to Richmond to cater a Board of Director's dinner for approx 40 guests. From start to finish they were wonderful to work with. All of my communications with them were through email and Ali was very quick and thorough in his responses. I asked him to make recommendations and the menu he planned out for our buffet style dinner was perfect. Our guests were from all over the world but to say that every guest loved the food would be an understatement. It was a huge success! The three Otto's staff members that set up/served were also wonderful. Punctual, professional, kind, expressed a strong desire to please get everything perfect, and VERY hard working. They never paused for a moment. I would use Otto's for catering again in a heartbeat! ...and most likely will soon!
Absolutely delicious! The food is fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with care. Great portions, friendly service, and everything tasted amazing — highly recommend.

Head over heals in love with this place. Eating here made me daydream about moving to Charlottesville. This place is in the sweet spot of way better than your average kebab joint without white-tablecloth price tags or stuffiness. Hope I make it back to Cville so I can eat here again.

Otto Eats catered our 75-person wedding in June 2025, and we recommend them in the strongest terms! We had a difficult time choosing a caterer since we were looking for something to fit both our budget and our larger vision for the role food would play at our wedding, and many of the other options we tried failed to stand out. All it took was experiencing Ali’s hospitality and incredible food during our tasting to make it clear we had found that special vendor we were hoping for. Throughout the planning process, Ali was extremely fast and detailed in communicating with us whenever we had questions or needed to make adjustments. On the big day itself, the Otto Eats team brought their food truck and arrived early to set up. The food was fresh and delicious, from cocktail hour appetizers, to the main dinner buffet, dessert and into the late night snack. We also used their bartending service and they did an excellent job keeping the drinks flowing throughout the night. The entire team was professional, kind, and helped make sure everything ran smoothly. We really feel they went above and beyond, not just providing great food but also serving our guests like family. We are incredibly grateful to the Otto Eats team for being a part of our celebration, and we can’t wait to visit their restaurant for many anniversaries to come!
Friendly, fast and delicious! The pocket Falaway was fresh and filling and the atmosphere was bright, fun and the garage doors were rolled up for an open air space.
Such a great location, very quick and fresh food <3 The owner Halmund is amazing, the view and fresh air from the open windows is on a perfect corner right in downtown. Support the little shops!
Visiting from out of town. Took a chance on this place. It did not disappoint! Had it delivered. It came quickly, hot, and fresh. Order was correct. Prices are very reasonable. Highly recommend!

I got takeout this time but Otto’s is my favorite place in Charlottesville whether you eat in out take out. Everything is always fresh & very tasty. They are more than happy to explain what things are and the portions are generous.
The food truck was at polo at King Family Vineyards. Food was amazing!

Otto's recently catered our wedding of 125 people and absolutely knocked it out of the park. Ali and his team couldn't have been more helpful and professional. They were so easy to communicate with, so thorough in their planning and worked seamlessly with the venue to provide an unforgettable experience for us. Our guests raved about their food, and we were fortunate to go home with leftovers that still taste great. A testament to Ali and the business: we ran out of Tzatziki sauce and stopped by. He remembered us instantly and hooked us up without hesitating. 100000% would choose them again, but we're only getting married once haha. Worth every cent, and affordable in the oh-so-expensive wedding industry. Thanks, Ali!
Absolutely delicious food and amazing service. The ottoboom sauce was so good. Happy we dropped in!
Oh my god, this young man Leo is so sweet. He is the best one here. Thank you and for your delicious food

Amazing food, even BETTER service! The guys working here are so incredibly nice and the food is to die for. They have meat but this place is a vegetarians dream. When we come back to the area we will absolutely eat here again!
Literally the best fast eatery in Charlottesville. Opening a location in RVA as well!
Dashed through and it looked and smelled great
It was a more than wonderful experience with you, especially the young man, Leo. He had the best customer service and welcome ever.

Otto Eats is a fantastic spot in Charlottesville for authentic Turkish and Mediterranean food. The menu has something for everyone — meat lovers, vegetarians, and even vegan options — and everything is fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. The döner kebabs are a standout, packed with flavor and perfectly seasoned, and the falafel is crisp on the outside and soft on the inside. Portion sizes are generous, and the prices are very reasonable given the quality.

The atmosphere inside is warm and lively, with a casual, friendly vibe that makes it great for both quick lunches and relaxed dinners. The staff are welcoming and attentive, and even when the place gets busy, service stays smooth. I also love that Otto offers catering and a food truck — it really shows their dedication to sharing their food with the community.

If you’re in Charlottesville and craving Mediterranean comfort food, Otto Eats is absolutely worth a visit. Highly recommended for both locals and visitors!
Excellent food and Excellent service.
Perfect - every time!!

A little pricey but absolutely delicious! I haven’t had decent falafel for a long time and they didn’t disappoint. The chicken was way way better than the beef. The Otto Bun was amazing!! Recommend that over the bowl
Quick, easy and fresh with friendly service!
Simply excellent! avoid those tourist traps on the mall and eat here. rwasonable price, healthy, tasty and they have beers! WOOT, baby!
Amazing

Otto is great. In a small city with a few Turkish restaurants, Otto stands out for being great if you want a quick, tasty bite. Flavors feel a bit toned down, likely to appeal to locals, but everything is very well made.
The employees were very friendly and helped me build my own bowl, providing lots of recommendations. Everything was delicious- lots of dips and salads! Thank you for a wonderful meal!
Lovely restaurant, they have great bowls, panini, wraps, tried all and loved it
Great food, great ambiance and service was good too.
Wow! The food is amazing.  The fried dough balls have a wonderful set center. Excellent experience.
Absolutely delicious! Great vibe, service, and most importantly the baklava and burma kadayıf!

I've gotten otto three times for company events and he's been a hit everytime. It's become everyone's favorite catering option for events we do. I don't think you can beat the quantity and quality they provide!

There's plenty of food everytime and no one leaves hungry. Definitely will be ordering from him again in the future.

Also definitely consider the baklava, it's definitely worth it!

We had a large group and the owner and employees were so kind and hospitable. The food was fresh and so good! The beet salad, hummus, falafel, pita chips, stuffed grape leaves, baklava… everything tasted great. I will come again when I’m back in Charlottesville!
I always enjoy the freshly prepared meals at Otto Eats when I’m in Charlottesville.  The staff is always super nice. Thanks guys.

During our trip to Charlottesville, we asked ChatGPT where we could find a healthy, satisfying, and delicious meal. Based on its suggestion, we came to Otto Eats — and we’re so glad we did!

Three of us dined here and tried the Combo Anatolia,istanbowl, and Alaturca wrap plates. Every dish was incredibly flavorful and far beyond our expectations.

The staff were professional, welcoming, and genuinely good at what they do. Their communication and hospitality made us feel right at home.

We’re already looking forward to our next visit to Charlottesville — and we will definitely be coming back here again. Highly recommended!
I’ve tried many Turkish restaurants, this one is the best so far. It offers the best Turkish food available in the US.
Hello, I can recommend it to everyone. It's a nice place, very healthy and clean, and the staff is very nice. I can say that it's the only place for delicious food.

This place is amazing! Coffee is real:) The dishes are authentic , which is also important! Prices attractive! Restroom is clean! The staff were helpful and polite!! Highly recommend! The public parking is opposite. Thank you!!!
Wishing you blessings in your business!

Such a cute little place with amazing food! Service is consistently amazing and I’ve never had a dish that wasn’t delicious. The atmosphere is adorable and the location is perfect, just off of the downtown mall. Cannot recommend this place enough!

Food 5/5, service 5/5, atmosphere 5/5. Really glad we found this place in downtown Charlottesville! Host was personable, the decoration on the walls is punny and fits the vibe. We got two bowls and both of them were fantastic. We would definitely revisit when in town!
clean food and fantastic staff. thank you!
It's really good falafel on a great bowl. Price is comparable to other options in the area.

Was visiting for a wedding and walked by Otto earlier in the day.  Returned for a pre dinner rehearsal snack and it did not disappoint.  Had the wrap with beef which was made to order and it was outstanding.  Had a good selection of beer and soda available too.  The side dishes look terrific.
We happen to park next to Ottos, saw the menu and decided to give it a try. It was excellent! A vegan paradise!
They would be great if only they could include their sauces in take away packages!

As an office manager I use many different places to cater certain events & staff lunches for my work and Otto's is a favorite! We use them frequently and have always been happy with the delicious food and fantastic service. The whole process is extremely easy and their staff are fantastic to work with.
Great communication and yummy food make Otto's a 10/10 for me.

I come here every time I visit Charlottesville and they never disappoint! Great options for the vegetarians—the falafel is tasty in a bowl or a pita. Nice beer and drinks selection too. And extremely friendly service, lovely staff, and a nice space to sit and eat.

We love this place because you can choose from a yummy combination or make your own wrap or bowl. The prices are decent and the serving size is appropriately matched. The kids bowl is a little pricey but good for a picky eater. Fresh ingredients! Friendly staff!
We go there regularly every month
Yummy!
Best people. Love this place

Food was fresh, delicious, & plentiful! The service was great & the servers were very good. Decor was a fun look at food & art. Loved the t-shirts! And the "windows" are actually garage doors that they opened up so you're directly looking into the street. The weather was mild & perfect for this setting.

The very eager and friendly staff were welcoming and kind. The food was delicious and unique (maybe less so for folks who live in metropolitan areas). We were quite delighted. The Turkish coffee had me buzzing nicely for the 3+ hour drive home. We'll be back, for sure!
Delicious , authentic. Quick friendly service

FIRST TIME 5/5/25. ATMOSPHERE WAS GREAT. SEATING WITH THE SLIDING GARAGE WINDOWS. FOOD WAS TASTY. BAKLAVA WAS FRESH AND SWEET OF COURSE.
THE STAFF WAS ACCOMMODATIVE. THANK YOU. ☺️ 😋
I WILL BE BACK.
My go-to spot when I'm craving falafel! A variety of healthy options. Vegan and vegetarian friendly
Perfect spot for a delicious, fresh, healthy, reasonably-priced Mediterranean meal downtown! Friendly service, and bringing a high school group here during Tom Tom has become a tradition. Delish!

The fact I've never posted a review of this place is shameful. I eat there at least twice a week. This past week, as a bachelor with my wife out of town I ate there 6 out of 7 days. I think part of my reasoning for no review was that I don't want you there. I like walking in and not waiting, and I know it's so good, that if you knew, you'd be standing there in my way, and I don't want you in my way. I started as a wrap guy, but my wife always got the istanbowl. I hate that name. I hate the notion of bowls in general. Is it a salad? It just seems like a mess of food. Until I woke up hungry and pretty much robbed her leftovers. Now I'm all bowl, all the time. Bulger with hummus, LOTS of beets, cabbage, celery dip, chicken, and tzatziki, oh, and a little eggplant. I get three meals out of it, but that's because I eat like a bird which you wouldn't think possible due to my rotund presence, but it's true. I only clued my coworkers to it as a lunch option a month ago, and I work two blocks away. Stay away from this place. It's too good for you. There's a Wendy's around the corner. You like Wendy's. You LOVE Wendy's. Otto's rosemary fries are too complicated for you. The little containers of Baklava by the register taste like if honey were a singularity. Don't buy those. Stay safe. Stay Wendy's. Ignore THE FACT that every single employee of Otto's is genuinely concerned with making sure you're happy with your food. Ignore it. You are better off enjoying the dead-eyed stares of underpaid Wendy's employees. I spent plenty of years in fast food, I made Krystal Burgers for crying out loud, don't bother me at Otto's. It's my safe place and It's too good for you.

At Otto, the vibe is so welcoming, and the food is just fantastic. I'm a big fan of making my own pita sandwich with their juicy beef doner and all the tasty ingredients and sauces they offer. Everything always tastes fresh and flavorful.

Ottobun is my favorite item you should definitely try it.
And the baklava they have is amazing.
Great food, great atmosphere.
Very comforting food. Made me feel good all day.
Fresh authentic Turkish food. Delicious made to order. The doner reminded me of the ones I used to get in Europe. This place is a must try.
It was good but bit expensive.

This place is soooo good every single time. I've never dined in, but I've ordered it a few times from doordash. I've tried a few of the burritos, pre-made and the build your own. I'm 99% sure that every single ingredient and combination would still somehow compliment each other, no matter what you add 😅 my biggest recommendation is the hazelnut cake, it's light and fluffy like a mousse with a crunchy layer, it's quite literally heaven and I wish I could buy a whole cake of it 🥲🤤 the loaded fries are insane and honestly one order is enough as an entire meal. We have leftovers every time, no matter what we order. Everything is super flavorful and satisfying, and feels healthy on the gut. 1 million out of 10.
Incredible fresh food, and they have options for everyone!
Delicious, hip, college town fast casual. Got lunch here. Veggie bowl with falafel made for a perfect lunch.

Excellent food, we had the Chicken and Beef Doner sandwiches. Both were well seasoned. The fries could be a little bit more crispy; however, the food and experience was enjoyable. The experience is good, as it is like a Chipotle style, which you select what you would like and the various toppings. The service is pretty quick as you move down the food line. Will come back

Best shawarma joint so far in Charlottesville with fast and amazing service, my last visit i got help by layth he is the best and smile always, with this teams i bet this Business going to grow up more and more I'm highly recommended this location to have the best Turkish streets food

I went to a friend’s wedding that this place catered, and it was incredible. I really enjoyed it, and talked with my wife specifically about how good the food was when I got home. The next day we were looking for a place to eat, and accidentally stumbled upon this place, not realizing it was the same place, and ordered it again.

The food was just as good the second time, and the people who work there are incredibly friendly and great. I’m so happy I got to support their restaurant twice. They really deserve it!

Keep it up!

Oh and it was so good I forgot to take a picture, so no pictures for this review. I was too busy laughing about how we accidentally went twice.
Food is amazing, large portions but it's good for you food so you don't feel guilty
Otto is the best fast casual restaurant in Charlottesville! The staff is incredibly kind and falafel is the best I've ever had.
Food tastes fantastic but $8.25 for a minuscule salad is a total ripoff. First time I’ve had any issues with Otto.
Was in town to assist with family members. This place was really good!  Falafel was great. Service was super friendly.
Fantastic spot!!!

Yum! Everything in the bowl I ordered was delicious and fresh. I don't think I've had hummus that good since the 90s (before its mass manufacture for grocery). Their baklava was an amazing treat, and being from NYC I take baklava very seriously! :) I hope to try more of the menu soon.
One of my favorite food spots in Charlottesville, Ali and the team made an incredible food experience and welcoming spot that always has me craving a trip back for more.
Beat
Best food I love it

Grabbed lunch here while walking around the downtown mall and enjoying the day off. What an absolute gem of a place! I ordered the Combo Efes bowl and loved everything in it. With a lettuce base, they pile on chicken döner and three falafel surrounded by their bean salad, sumac onions, red cabbage, ezme, and hummus. This beautiful assortment is then topped with a generous drizzle of tahini. I can’t wait to return and try more of the menu. Also, adding them to my catering list as well.
Always solid. Super friendly staff
The staff are always friendly and helpful. The rosemary fries are always fresh and the meat is always good. We also really like their baklava.

Had a custom bowl which featured many of their sides (and the delicious falafel of which I am not always a fan but Otto’s were delicious!)…everything (!!!!) was good! I wish they were near where I live! Thanks for a great birthday lunch! I don’t need tablecloths and pricey plates…just good food. Being vegetarian it was a super menu.
So good !!!!!!
lovely fast casual eatery on the downtown mall. reasonable prices for what you get, great and kind service, wonderful food. this one is a go to for me!
Some of the best food we’ve had here. The staff is super nice and friendly and it’s very clean!
Excellent food and service! Fresh falafel.

Eat here.

Out of stater passing through. Wonderful place that exceeded expectations. Had an amazing kebab wrap w fries. Food was fantastic as someone who had tried from many places including international. Fries and tzatziki sauce were excellent. They’re customer service is top notch. Incredibly friendly place. 10/10 recommend and sad I’m not here longer to try more food here.
An absolute underrated cville gem! A person recommended it as I was walking past and I've been a regular since. The tatziki is delicious, and the falafel is always crispy. Definitely stop by!
Delicious, healthy food, very helpful and friendly service esp. special thanks to Ms Gokce who patiently informed me of the ingredients of each dish since I have food allergies.
Super yummy food, great atmosphere, fast service, kind staff, and plenty of seating.

We’ve been dying to try Otto for awhile now and we’re beating ourselves up that we haven’t gone sooner! The food is off the charts good. It’s comfort food you didn’t know you needed. The staff was super helpful in helping us choose the best items on the menu and welcoming us in. We will definitely be back!
Healthy choices! Newchoices
Excellent food, must go place

Absolutely delicious food! Definitely a place I’d come for any occasion, or just a normal day.
10/10, perfection!
Huge fan of Turkish food, this is our first visit here and we were NOT disappointed. Excellent staff, very friendly and the food was even better!
So. Damn. Good.

The food is great, but even more importantly to me, the people who work here are SO KIND. My friend has a severe allergy to black pepper and they went out of their way to ensure everything they gave her had no black pepper.
Excellent food, many choices. Large portions - nice! Bowls have a lot of delicious parts! Wrap huge! Rosemary fries very good. Service excellent. Will be back to try something else next time.

I came here in person a few weeks ago and it was SO good.  Then I ordered delivery tonight and The Mediterranean Bowl is absolutely incredible, even after a long car ride.  This is very healthy food but extremely flavorful and satisfying.  10/10.  My new favorite place.  I forgot to take a photo before it was all gone, sorry.

Their food was delicious! We ordered a build your own pita with beef and a bowl and both were yummy. I like their eggplants the best. Also had fries and lentil soup. The atmosphere is cute and clean.  The staff was very nice. We went back next day for the pita wrapes with falafel: they were also great. I highly recommend!
Amazing food, great portions, and service with a smile!
The food is amazing and the staff are some of the kindest people I have ever encountered. Reasonably priced delicious authentic food with kind people - I can’t ask for more
Really tasty and fresh Turkish food

The food was ok at most. Cold soup was served and had to pay $5 for a tea that is usually a complimentary add on in the Turkish culture. Im writing this review bc the tea was bagged tea and not from the pot. Also who sells alc at a doner spot in 2024?

I decided to have lunch at Otto after my friend recommended it. I had the Istanbowl, which was delicious. Gokce was so sweet and friendly, as she patiently explained my options and helped me make a decision. I will be back!
Bf’s and I *absolute favorite spot * to eat while visiting Charlottesville. A vegetarian’s dream.

Food was great, I had a beef wrap with Baklava, service was perfect, people were very welcoming and accommodating, particularly Hassana and Leo, thank u guys for the good experience, I will be back for sure

Delicious authentic food from Mediterranean. As an originally Turkish person, I can tell this is one of the best Turkish food that you can find in the US. They adapted to bowl serving style and combined with Turkish taste. Definitely recommended.

I love eating here when I'm in town! The dishes are artistically crafted with layers of flavors and colors. No flat, rubbery pita here; soft and fluffy every time. The employees are friendly and welcoming. It's always a pleasure to dine here!

Great food with fast service.
We got rice bowl with falafel. Falafel was crispy and flavorful. All the toppings and dressings were great as well.
Con: little bit pricey for the quantity- $16 for a falafel bowl.
Food was great and the staff was very welcoming.. Little pricey at around $16 a bowl

We stopped in here just to give it a try - wanted some apps before heading to dinner at another place. We’re only here for one night so, desperate to get a taste of several places. Leo was super cool & accommodating making us a little sampler platter. We LOVED everything!! The eggplant = amazing. The hummus = amazing. Grape leaves = amazing. Such a great place. Fun tshirts too!!

Amazing! Found my new go-to place for lunch in Cville. I got the "Istanbowl"--nice variety of flavors and textures, veggies and meat. Perfect with a beer (in an iced glass 👍🏼) on a hot summers day. Attractive modern, clean open atmosphere. Food is always fresh and ready for eat-in or take-out.

I travel often to Charlottesville and this is my staple for a great lunch/dinner every time. The food is always fresh and they FILL up their bowls. They also have a great assortment of authentic Turkish treats and drinks.

Myself and 2 of my brothers were looking for a good Halal place to eat, and to our wonderful surprise it surpassed our expectations. From the start service was spot on, we were greeted by Hassan with a very welcoming smile. Felt like I was home.
We were nervous about the food, going in a little before closing. Fresh fresh fresh only 30 minutes before closing. All flavors and temperatures were perfect. And Hassan even made sure to get me a fresh pita that was absolutely delicious. I will definitely be stopping by here any and every time I pass through Charlottesville.
Gracie & Dave are 💯💕 Clean/Fast/Hot/Delish
A quaint corner shop with awesome Mediterranean food.  Even our picky 6yo grand daughter enjoyed her bowl!  The staff treated us with a desert pastry to top it all off.
Really good , recommend it, the guy with the glasses was so nice 🤝🏼
Absolutely amazing food, flavor and service!  Every time I drive by Charlottesville I stop.  If you are not sure try it!  The flavors are out of this world!!

If you're looking for a healthy feast that's lighter, aromatic, fresh, and savory, go to Otto. I recommend one of their generous specialty bowls that's loaded with Turkish and Mediterranean ingredients (they'll talk you through the things you aren't familiar with, don't worry). And, if you're able, try an Efes Pilsner, the #1 beer in Turkey. I'm telling you, if I lived in Charlottesville, I'd be at Otto 3 times a week. Good food, and good people that make you feel at home. Amazing!

Mediterranean Chipotle.  And that's not an insult.  The cafeteria style service made the experience quick and easy. The food was tasty and very filling. All and all a good meal made by friendly people.
Great food! The people are very kind and quick.
The food is great but you guys forgot to add chicken to my Mediterranean bowl today

This is a half eaten ottobun because I devoured half before taking a pic! Food is filling and is delish. You can create your own or get a specialty. I highly recommend their rosemary fries and the accompanied sauce. I think its a cilantro sauce, it's so so good.
Excellent food!

The best food l have ever tried!
They went above and beyond to make my experience.
Now coming back every day💙
Excellent service, friendly people, and delicious food 🌯 couldn’t be better.

Came here for lunch with my family.  Everyone got something different, and everyone was blown away.  We will definitely be back whenever we come near Charlottesville!  Foods tried: Ottobun, Alaturca Wrap, Istanbowl with falafel

Absolutely fantastic. The food was unique, delicious, you got a lot of it, and it was relatively cheap. I got the ottobun and when I picked it up it had HEFT to it, and it tasted SO GOOD! Would recommend.

Grabbed lunch here a few weeks ago while in Charlottesville and we cannot stop thinking about it. I got the chicken ottoban and my fiance got the beef and we shared some loaded fries with chicken. Everything was really good, even our toddler seemed to think so!

The food was served to us super fast it’s more of a buffet I guess because we didn’t wait at all. Both combos were great the meat was fresh and the mixture of sauce was great. You can taste the freshness of falafel and salad as well.

Very good service and like I said it was super fast. The atmosphere was nice and comfy. I was here for a visit otherwise this would be a great spot to regularly visit.

Otto Turkish Street Food is an absolute gem!  The staff is welcoming and attentive and goes above and beyond to ensure an amazing dining experience. I love the bowls and wraps – always fresh and packed with flavor! And the baklava never disappoints - easily the best I've ever tasted! The attentive staff, delicious food, and vibrant atmosphere makes Otto the perfect spot to unwind!

Very nice atmosphere for a comfortable dinner with my two children and husband. Food was fresh, good quality, and well seasoned. The staff was very friendly, and it’s a really nice refuge from the downtown Charlottesville.

Hummus was re absolutely delicious, and so is the falafel.

Gluten Free
A delicious reinterpretation of homemade Turkish cuisine, beautifully presented in a convenient food bowl format without compromising the authentic homemade taste.
